items.title: Ender Prisoners
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
This time, there's no escape... You have become a prisoner of the End! Show off your prison garments and wow (or scare) your friends with the new Ender Prisoner skin pack! With these skins, things might feel like a horror, but at least you fit in here!

- 10 prison-tastic skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Heist Masks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to don your mask and hide your identity because the big heist is coming up! The city is teeming with places waiting for you to swoop in with the new Heist Masks skin pack, are you ready to go?

- 10 criminally good skins
- Don't get caught...
- By 57Digital

items.title: Frog Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
It's time to get ribbit! Wait... Ribbit? Hop into this new skin pack and become the bounciest Frog Teen in the mine! Hop across lakes and onto your stylish lily pad as the coolest frog on the block.

- 10 bouncing skins
- Lily pads not included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Alice Kimono HD
items.creator: Impress
items.description:
Alice in Wonderland-style Japanese clothing HD skins.

-A fine kimono with check patterns, hearts and red roses which resembles the story.
-The choices are Alice, White Rabbit, The Hatter, Cheshire Cat, Queen of Hearts and soldiers of heart and diamond.

-Creator: Nanairo

items.title: Stylish Hoodies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Play Minecraft in style with these expressive hoodies! With every color in the rainbow, you're sure to find your favorite color in this pack. 

+ 14 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique colorful hoodies to express yourself!

items.title: Neon Dancers 2
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Dance the night away in these glowing artistic skins! Choose from a variety of colors and styles. Light up the night with your neon energy! 

+ Unique design, neon themed!
+ 30 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Collect all neon packs!

items.title: Block Cameo 2
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Even more camouflage skins and even more ways to trick and troll your friends!

+Comes with 1 free skin!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Animal Hats
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: The best way to camouflage is with your favorite animals. Try out these silly hats and blend into your favorite herds!

items.title: Summer Paradise
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: It's time to take a bit of a break, but only while looking your best.

items.title: Block Cameo 1
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Are you a master of camouflage? Troll and trick your friends with these camouflage skins!

+Comes with 1 free skin!
+By FallStudios

items.title: Pirate Adventure
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Set sail on an epic journey in Pirate Adventure, where a mighty ship and hidden island treasures await you. 
Explore the high seas, uncover secrets, and create your own legendary pirate story.

items.title: Billionaires Modern Houses
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Always wanted to be rich and have an infinite amount of money and cars? Explore this beautiful city and drive luxury sports cars, planes or helicopters like a millionaire, billionaire or trillionaire pro. Live a posh life in furnished modern mansion houses!

+ Perfect holiday while staying at home
+ 600x600 Deluxe Modern City
+ Drive many vehicles

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: TNT War
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Battle with a real bang! With lots of explosive skins, gear up and get ready for war. Using dynamite sticks and TNT, blast your way into fierce fighting mood. Light your fuse and destroy everything in your way. Defend and protect because you are the bomb!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Teen Bees
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Bee awesome while you buzz around a flower garden. Gather up pollen to make honey when you role-play in black and yellow insect skins. Will you be a worker and build the hive? Or be the queen teen bee and rule the nest? Get ready to show off your best dance moves to the whole colony.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Glitch Hackers
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Blink and look again. Was it a glitch or are you really a hacker? Choose from 8 imperfect skins that may look a little strange at first. Gear up and role-play as a computer pro and make everyone you meet wonder what is going on. Are you an error or are you a bug?

1 free skin included!

items.title: Rare Gems
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Everyone knows about the classic ores like diamonds, gold, and emeralds... but what about saphires, rubies, and amethysts? Camouflage yourself in the caves, or make a dazzling appearence, dripping in gemstones!

- 8 different skins to choose from!
- Pick the gem that suits you best!

items.title: Space Slime HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
3...2...1... Blast off! These highly gelatinous beings have been pulled from the deep corners of space itself and contained to glass containers for viewing your pleasure. Dress up as an astronaut, alien, or a portion of the galaxy when you wear these skins.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Anime Teenagers
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Anime vibes are back in town! Live in a city of the most hardcore nerds and become part of the family! Binge watch the most exciting shows and become the best of friends with the other fans. Let your free spirits shine through!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Freedom Style
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Embrace your new style! Be free as a bird flying through the sky while exploring this entirely new Minecraft world. Explore new parts of the modern city and become best friends with all citizens. The lively neighborhood will greet you with arms wide open! Free your inner spirit!

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 stylish skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Frenzy Mobs
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Mob season is just around the corner! Get ready for a frenzy of mobs! Creepers, zombies, and even spiders have arrived in the city. Dress as a trendy mob and enjoy your free time among your other mob friends. Fill your backpacks with candy and explore the wonders of this new Minecraft realm. Good luck!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 mob-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Anime Streetwear
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
These anime teens aren't here to mess around. Show off the coolest streetwear to all of your friends!

+ 12 anime teen skins
+ A variety of outfit types
+ 2 FREE skins!

items.title: Hidden Underground Base
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Pull the trigger and the door will open wide for you! Live in a luxurious hidden base accompanied with your dream cars!

- Massive underground base!
- Hide from your friends in a secret hideaway!
- Secret entrance!
- Secret garage door!

items.title: Billionaire Cliffside Mansion
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A luxurious mansion for the billionaires who wish to have a majestic view! Play survival in luxury like never before!

- Drive your exclusive sport car!
- Massive modern mansion!
- Beautiful cliffside view!

And much more!

items.title: Simple Spawns Magic Forest 2
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
A magic forest sounds like a fun place, right? However, nobody told you that this enchanted looking settlement would be magically dangerous… Time to clean up and claim the area!

- A cute little town with a magical charm.
- A cursed mine worth checking out.
- Bring a friend along… you know… for extra protection.
